title: 3.4 Persons Arrested under Local & Special Laws : A total of 28,33,525 persons were arrested during 1981 for committing various offences under the local and special laws against the 28,31,972 persons arrested during 1980. This showed an increase of 0.1 per cent in 1981 over 1980 in the number of arrests.
